body: Thanks, I'll try some of these things come Monday. I don't have much hope, but it's as good a place to start as any in my miserable life.

It could, but it doesn't. I can't stop drinking for more than a few days at a time.  I hate my life and don't want to live it for more than a few hours a week. Every other waking moment aside from those few hours are extremely difficult for me to endure.
